shared_elements: schematic human/anthropomorphic figures with raised or outstretched arms
rows of repeated small marks or signs
registers/bands of motifs stacked across the surface
frontal figure with prominent head and splayed limbs
justification: Both surfaces use flat, highly schematic silhouette figures — anthropomorphs with raised arms and profile animals — plus rows of small repeated marks arranged in loose horizontal registers, which is a generic correspondence any schematic tradition could produce. The specific content diverges sharply: A shows a hierarchy of crouching quadrupeds/felines, birds and a large-beaked bird over a body-like lower panel, while B shows manned boats with crew strokes, a figure holding a horizontal bar and a bird-headed staff, motifs entirely absent from A.
